speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any pain or burning sensation when you urinate, and have you noticed any foul-smelling discharge from the vagina? I need to distinguish between endometritis and a urinary tract infection.

text: Given the uterine tenderness and fever following a prolonged labor, I suspect postpartum endometritis rather than a simple UTI. REQUEST TEST: CBC
